messages:
Renee H: Quick sync: we are bundling the Snowflake + Databricks connectors into a single marketplace package (incl. Qdrant backend adapters) and need a soak/runbook before we request listing approval. Proposed soak window next Fri 09:00 PT. Who can own the runbook + packaging?
Tom B: I can own packaging. Plan: umbrella helm chart that pulls in connector, gateway, and optional edge adapter. Need confirmation on artifact locations for wheels and docker images.
Marta V: I'll own runbook + tests. Need sample delta table, Snowpipe notification flow, and an example Unity Catalog policy. Can we get those assets uploaded to the partnership drive?
Oliver C: I'll coordinate with eng-infra to provision staging cluster and the NVMe-attached vector backend for performance testing (partner hardware). Note: partner requires mTLS between gateway and vector nodes.
Renee H: Acceptance checklist draft: helm deploy succeeds, connector processes 10k records in 10 minutes with <1% error, dedupe & schema-drift handled, persistence verified in vector backend, helm uninstall cleans up CRs. Also capture CPU/GPU & NVMe I/O metrics.
Tom B: Packaging decisions: publish helm tgz to our chartmuseum snapshot repo and include a values.example.yaml in the package. We'll not include any partner keys. Use placeholders and point to KMS flow in docs.
Marta V: Test vectors: small rows (~1KB), large rows (~256KB), repeated ids for dedupe, and intentionally corrupted json for schema drift. I'll add soak script and expected assertions.
Renee H: Timeline: Tom produce helm sample + values.example by Wed EOD, Marta produce runbook & tests by Thu noon, Oliver provision hardware + kube creds by Thu 16:00, soak Fri 09:00. Legal to confirm embargo by Thu.
marketplace-bot: Action created: "bundle-soak-runbook" assigned to @Marta V, due 2026-05-07 12:00.
Tom B: Helm values snippet we'll include in docs:
```
connector:
  image: registry.redwood.com/partner/connector:SNAPSHOT
  replicaCount: 2
ingestGateway:
  mtls:
    enabled: true
vectorBackend:
  type: qdrant
  batchSize: 128
  storageClass: nvme-fast
```
Marta V: Run command for soak we'll run in staging (uses partner token):
```
TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/partner_token)
./scripts/soak_runner.sh --endpoint https://staging-gateway.redwood/ingest \
  --token $TOKEN --payload tests/soak_large.json --rate 40 --duration 600
```
Oliver C: Infra notes: NVMe pool is in us-west-2-staging, cluster name rh-staging-edge. I'll create a service account with only necessary RBAC and upload kubeconfig to secure drive. Also will enable node-exporter + iostat collection.
Tom B: We should also include instructions for Databricks init script (to pip install wheel) and Snowflake stage + Snowpipe examples in the runbook.
Marta V: Working on the runbook draft at drive.redwood.com/teams/partnerships/vector-bundle-runbook (sharing perms). It will include: preflight checklist, helm values, init scripts, smoke commands, acceptance checks, rollback steps, and SI handoff notes.
Renee H: Market/announce plan: embargo until legal and security sign-off. If all green, coordinate joint announcement date with partner marketing. Do not publish marketplace listing until legal clears export/data residency.
Oliver C: One extra: partner hardware has firmware version requirement. I'll post exact SKU+firmware in the runbook and gate soak on that.
Marta V: Acceptance assertions I'll check automatically after soak: ingest count, error rate, vector count matches expected, KV cache warmed (hit rate >50%), and no OOMs/crashes.
Tom B: CI note: add a pipeline job that publishes the helm package to snapshot repo when PR merges to partner-connector/main. We'll include CHANGELOG and minimal release notes.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: review checklist -> schedule legal review (assigned to @Renee H), due Thu 17:00.
Renee H: Thanks team. Next: Tom helm sample Wed, Marta runbook Thu, Oliver infra Thu, soak Fri. Post logs here when soak completes and we'll decide go/no-go for listing. :rocket:
